title: Affine coordinates compatible with chosen lifts for a nonpositive flat resolution
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme], B=i_*O_Z, and q:K→B[0] a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. Assume K is a cochain complex of O_Y-module sheaves [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], all its terms are flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and K^j is zero for every j>0. For n≥0 put Q=H^{-n}(Tot(K⊗B[0])) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. On each affine U put A_U=Γ(Y,U), I_U=ker(i)(U), P_U the chosen projective resolution of A_U/I_U, and T_U=P_U⊗(A_U/I_U) [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]. There exist A_U-linear equivalences c_U:H_n(T_U)≃Γ(U,Q) such that for every basic inclusion V⊆U, with phi the ring restriction, there exist a quotient homomorphism psi:A_U/I_U→A_V/I_V, chain map a:P_U→Res_phi(P_V), and chain map k:T_U→Res_phi(T_V) satisfying psi(mk(x))=mk(phi(x)), pi_V a_0=psi pi_U, and k_j(x⊗y)=a_j(x)⊗psi(y), restriction sends c_U(x) to c_V(e(H_n(k)(x))) for every x, where e is the exact restriction-of-scalars homology isomorphism. The restriction equation is asserted only for these chosen compatible lifts, not for arbitrary supplied lifts. No arbitrary unbounded K-flat complex is compared with K.

source.place: Tag 08DX(2), affine tensor calculation; Tags 06YG and 06YB for K-flat comparison, 01I9 for affine sections, and 00LS(1) for choosing augmented resolution lifts

proof.text: Bounded-above termwise flatness makes K K-flat. Specialize the proved natural K-flat derived tensor comparison to the constant functors K and B[0]. Since q is a quasi-isomorphism, Q(q) is invertible. Tensor its inverse with the identity of Q(B[0]), compose with the K-flat comparison, and apply derived homology and the homologyFunctorFactors isomorphism. This gives a global sheaf isomorphism eQ from intrinsic derived self-Tor to H^{-n}(K tensor B[0]).

Take the intrinsic affine coordinates c from the new geometric lemma and compose each with the linear equivalence on sections induced by eQ. For each basic inclusion the kernel ideal restriction containment lets the proved quotient-resolution tensor comparison construct psi,a,k with the quotient, augmentation and pure-tensor equations.

Apply the intrinsic coordinate restriction equation to those supplied psi,a,k. Naturality_apply of eQ.hom gives res(eQ_U(c_U(x)))=eQ_V(res(c_U(x))). Substitute the intrinsic equation and use congrArg eQ_V. This is precisely the required equation for the composed coordinates, with the same exact restriction-of-scalars homology isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Transport intrinsic derived self-Tor coordinates via the proved K-flat derived tensor counit and Q(q); choose algebraic augmented lifts by 00LS(1), then use sheaf-map naturality.

theorem exists_selfTor_nonpositive_chosen_comparisons
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (q : K ⟶ (CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)))
    (hbounded : ∀ j : ℤ, 0 < j → IsZero (K.X j))
    (hflat : ∀ j : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlat (K.X j)) (hq : QuasiIso q) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Y.sheaf
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := CochainComplex.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q := (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K (S.obj B)
      (curriedTensor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)))).homology
        (-(n : ℤ))
    ∃ c : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).mapHomologicalComplex (.down ℕ)).obj
            (projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
              ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).complex).homology n) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)]
              Q.val.obj (op U.1),
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1),
          let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          let C := (Γ(Y, V.1) : Type u)
          let I := i.ker.ideal U
          let J := i.ker.ideal V
          let φ := (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
          let P := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))
          let R := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))
          let TA := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)
          let TC := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)
          ∃ (ψ : (A ⧸ I) →+* (C ⧸ J))
            (a : P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj R.complex)
            (k : TA.obj P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj (TC.obj R.complex)),
            (∀ x : A, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (φ x)) ∧
            (∀ x : P.complex.X 0, R.π.f 0 (a.f 0 x) = ψ (P.π.f 0 x)) ∧
            (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : P.complex.X j) (y : A ⧸ I),
              k.f j (x ⊗ₜ[A] y) = (show R.complex.X j from a.f j x) ⊗ₜ[C] (ψ y)) ∧
            let e := ((TC.obj R.complex).sc n).mapHomologyIso
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ)
          ∀ x, Q.val.map (homOfLE h).op (c U x) =
            c V (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n x))
